change_summary: Add verification guidance to request order ID / full email up front and accept the first successful lookup match without re-confirming.
reason_for_change: Task 54 (costliest, $0.6682) had 3 failed find_user calls before success, each adding a turn and tool call. Guiding the agent to request a strong identifier (order ID or full email) up front and to accept the first match reduces failed-lookup retry fan-out, cutting turns and tool calls on verification-heavy tasks while preserving the required BOTH-factor verification, so success is unaffected.
reason_accepted_or_rejected: rejected: first proxy run did not improve — no cost improvement beyond noise: per-task cost 0.473301 >= threshold 0.448779 (best mean 0.479572 - 1σ·0.030793)
hypothesis: The identity-verification loop wastes turns (task 54 spent 6 turns retrying name/email combinations); adding a concise rule to request the most reliable identifier (order ID or full email) up front and to accept the first successful match without re-confirming reduces failed lookup retries.
